12:28 Local Time, 10:28 GMT, 15:58 IST:Looks like they're going off as the drizzle picks up. Ackerman would be grateful that he got to open his account in Test cricket before they decided to stop play. He waves to someone in the crowd with a big smile on his face while walking off. Meanwhile, the groundstaff have covered the square. Frustrating for the crowd that has turned up. The start was delayed by 2 hours to begin with, and now after just 5.3 overs there's an interruption. Anyway, in the little play we got, Australia weren't at their best, especially Starc. There were problems with the landing area for both bowlers and the rhythm wasn't quite right. Word is that Lunch has been taken.
